category: embedding and reranker API, lifetime free token allowance

free_tier.stated: The first 200 million tokens for voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4 and voyage-code-4, or the first 50 million tokens for voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2 and voyage-code-2, are free for every account. The sentence above the embeddings table also names voyage-code-3 and voyage-multilingual-2, which the tables list as older models with no free tokens. The first 200M text tokens and 150B pixels for voyage-multimodal-3.5 and voyage-multimodal-3 are free, and the first 200 million tokens for the rerankers rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite are free for each account; the sentence above the reranker table also names rerank-2.5, rerank-2.5-lite, rerank-2 and rerank-2-lite, which the older-models table lists with no free tokens. Older models carry no free tokens and Batch API usage does not draw on them. The page says only 'the first' tokens; whether the allowance resets is unverified.
free_tier.notes: the free-token sentence above the embeddings table names voyage-code-3, voyage-multilingual-2 and, above the reranker table, rerank-2.5, rerank-2.5-lite, rerank-2 and rerank-2-lite, while the tables give the 200 million tokens to voyage-code-4, rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite and list the named models in the older-models table with no free tokens; the tables are read as authoritative. After the free tokens, voyage-4 costs USD 0.06 per million tokens and voyage-4-lite USD 0.02. unverified: whether the allowance is counted per account for the life of the account or resets; the page says only 'the first' tokens

interface_detail: REST at https://api.voyageai.com/v1 (embeddings and rerank); official Python package voyageai; a Batch API and a Files API exist but are billed and excluded from the free tokens
tooling: official Python package (pip install voyageai) with the VOYAGE_API_KEY environment variable, or raw HTTP from any language
chaining: 200 million embedding tokens is enough to embed a large text corpus once; pair it with a free Postgres with pgvector or another free vector store so the index costs nothing either. A re-embed after a model change draws the allowance down again, and the allowance does not reset.

limits.value: 200 million free tokens per account on voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4 and voyage-code-4 and 50 million on voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2 and voyage-code-2; 200M text tokens and 150B pixels on the multimodal models; 200 million on rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite

unverified: the rate-limit table lists 2000 RPM and 8M TPM for voyage-4 and voyage-3.5 and 16M TPM for voyage-4-lite, but the usage-tier table ties Tier 1 to a payment method being added, so the limit of an account with no payment method is not stated

binding_note: the free tokens are a finite per-account allowance (200 million on the current models), which is large but not renewable; request limits for an account with no payment method are unverified

identity_cost.detail: an account is enough for an API key ('Upon creating an account, we instantly generate an API key'); the rate-limit page says the free tokens still apply after a payment method is entered and ties usage Tier 1 to adding one; unverified: the signup form fields and whether a card or phone is asked, because the dashboard redirects to a login page that answered HTTP 400 on every route tried

reliability_note: the free-token sentences above the embeddings and reranker tables of the pricing page name voyage-code-3, voyage-multilingual-2, rerank-2.5, rerank-2.5-lite, rerank-2 and rerank-2-lite, which the older-models table lists with no free tokens; the vendor markets Voyage AI as part of MongoDB
confidence_note: the free-token counts, the exclusion of batch usage and older models, the instant API key and the rate-limit table are quoted from vendor pages; the free account's rate limit and the signup fields are unverified.
